mapper.sql: id, source_type, source_organization_id, creator_user_id, title, difficulty_level, base_points, duration_minutes, scheduled_date, category_code, remark, reviewer_user_id, review_timeout_hours, recurrence_enabled, recurrence_end_date, status, published_at, created_at, updated_at, (SELECT recurrence.status FROM learn_task_recurrence recurrence WHERE recurrence.task_id = learn_task.id) AS recurrence_status
mapper.select: SELECT FROM learn_task WHERE id = #{id} FOR UPDATE
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO learn_task ( id, source_type, source_organization_id, creator_user_id, title, difficulty_level, base_points, duration_minutes, scheduled_date, category_code, remark, reviewer_user_id, review_timeout_hours, recurrence_enabled, recurrence_end_date, status ) VALUES ( #{task.id}, #{task.sourceType}, #{task.sourceOrganizationId, jdbcType=BIGINT}, #{task.creatorUserId}, #{task.title}, #{task.difficultyLevel}, #{task.basePoints}, #{task.durationMinutes}, #{task.scheduledDate}, #{task.categoryCode, jdbcType=VARCHAR}, #{task.remark, jdbcType=VARCHAR}, #{task.reviewerUserId}, #{task.reviewTimeoutHours}, #{task.recurrenceEnabled}, #{task.recurrenceEndDate, jdbcType=DATE}, #{task.status} )
mapper.update: UPDATE learn_task SET title = #{task.title}, difficulty_level = #{task.difficultyLevel}, base_points = #{task.basePoints}, duration_minutes = #{task.durationMinutes}, scheduled_date = #{task.scheduledDate}, category_code = #{task.categoryCode, jdbcType=VARCHAR}, remark = #{task.remark, jdbcType=VARCHAR}, reviewer_user_id = #{task.reviewerUserId}, recurrence_enabled = #{task.recurrenceEnabled}, recurrence_end_date = #{task.recurrenceEndDate, jdbcType=DATE}, updated_at = CURRENT_TIMESTAMP WHERE id = #{task.id} AND status = 'DRAFT'
UPDATE learn_task SET status = 'PUBLISHED', published_at = CURRENT_TIMESTAMP, updated_at = CURRENT_TIMESTAMP WHERE id = #{id} AND status = 'DRAFT'
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO learn_task ( id, source_type, source_organization_id, creator_user_id, title, difficulty_level, base_points, duration_minutes, scheduled_date, category_code, remark, reviewer_user_id, review_timeout_hours, recurrence_enabled, recurrence_end_date, status, published_at, generation_type, origin_task_id ) SELECT #{targetTaskId}, source_type, source_organization_id, creator_user_id, title, difficulty_level, base_points, duration_minutes, #{targetDate}, category_code, remark, reviewer_user_id, review_timeout_hours, 0, NULL, 'PUBLISHED', CURRENT_TIMESTAMP, 'DEFERRED', COALESCE(origin_task_id, id) FROM learn_task WHERE id = #{sourceTaskId} AND status = 'PUBLISHED'

INSERT INTO learn_task ( id, source_type, source_organization_id, creator_user_id, title, difficulty_level, base_points, duration_minutes, scheduled_date, category_code, remark, reviewer_user_id, review_timeout_hours, recurrence_enabled, recurrence_end_date, status, published_at, generation_type, origin_task_id ) SELECT #{targetTaskId}, 'FAMILY', NULL, #{parentUserId}, title, difficulty_level, base_points, duration_minutes, #{targetDate}, category_code, remark, #{parentUserId}, review_timeout_hours, 0, NULL, 'PUBLISHED', CURRENT_TIMESTAMP, 'COPIED', COALESCE(origin_task_id, id) FROM learn_task WHERE id = #{sourceTaskId} AND source_type = 'FAMILY' AND creator_user_id = #{parentUserId} AND status = 'PUBLISHED'
